comments.author: @tysoncung
comments.text: Does it matter? Can’t they share the lake?

comments.author: @cosmic-minds-origin
comments.text: Lake Constance is also a huge drinking water source. About 4 million people in Baden-Württemberg get their tap water from it, and the shore states work together on keeping it clean even without an agreed border.

comments.author: @cosmic-minds-origin
comments.text: The detail the film could not fit: the three countries do not even agree on what kind of border is missing. Austria holds that the main basin is shared in common, Switzerland holds that there is a line down the middle, and Germany has never stated a position at all. It works because nobody has ever needed it to be settled.
